pi.frontmatter:
name: commander-tune
description: "扫最近全部会话（跨仓库）统计 commander 与各 skill 的调用轮次、你的反馈与版式违约，再诊断路由问题并给出改法。触发：优化路由 / 选错 skill / 技能集评估 / 审计技能使用 / 某个技能本身有什么漏洞"

cursor.frontmatter:
name: commander-tune
description: >-
  Audits recent chat logs across all repos (Pi sessions under
  ~/.pi/agent/sessions by default) to count per-skill invocations, the user's
  next-message reaction, and formatting violations; then diagnoses
  ~/.cursor/skills/commander/SKILL.md routing and the personal skill catalog
  and proposes concrete edits. Invoke when the user @names commander-tune,
  asks to optimize commander routing, fix wrong skill picks, audit skill
  usage, or find holes in a specific skill / evolve the skill set. Proposes or applies edits only after
  explicit apply confirmation unless the user says to apply directly.
disable-model-invocation: true
